notes.title: Upcoming Game Update: Version 0.0.06
notes.content:
[h1]Quick Info[/h1]

Character creation changes, saving starting to be implemented, new creator partnerships...

[h2]Developer Notes[/h2]
Overall a lot is going to be changing coming up! We have new character models, hair color, styles, skin tones, body types (Male and Female models), eye color, and character names! I know that sounds basic but we are now working with a few other creators to get most of the basics out of the way! We have enemies and animations for almost everything in the game. 

This next update is going to be testing the creation of characters and the replication of appearances using the new system. I think we are going to stick with Unreal Engine 5.1 for now because it has a lot of the tools I need to bring this game to where I want it to be.

[h3]Change Log[/h3]

[u][b]Game Update:[/b][/u] Version #0.0.06

[list]
[*][i]Female/Male model updates[/i]
[*][i]Profession resources added[/i]
[*][i]2 new enemies added[/i]
[*][i]New animations for new models[/i]
[*][i]Main Menu UI changes[/i]
[*][i]Particle effect portals added[/i]
[*][i]Weapons added[/i]
[*][i]2 Attacks added[/i]
[/list]


Though these are the basics of the type of posts, community events and other future events will be mostly on hold until I am further along in development with the exception of a Play Test planned for the end of April. Keep an eye out for posts and if you are craving more updates in between, there are shared media channels from the developers inside of the Discord. Come join us and fill out the suggestions forum with things you would like to see (please follow the guidelines for each channel).
